Healthy.action: Maintain optimal watering and nutrient levels.
Healthy.bio_remedy: Apply Neem oil (5ml/L) monthly as a preventive measure.

Late blight.action: Immediately remove and destroy infected leaves/plants. Do not compost.
Late blight.bio_remedy: Spray Trichoderma viride (5g/L) mixed with cow urine (10%) every 7 days.
Late blight.chemical_remedy: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5g/L) or Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) (2g/L).

Early blight.action: Ensure proper spacing for air circulation. Avoid overhead watering.
Early blight.bio_remedy: Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens (5g/L) at the base of the plant.
Early blight.chemical_remedy: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP (2g/L) or Propiconazole 25% EC (1ml/L).

Powdery mildew.action: Improve air flow. Water at the base, keeping leaves dry.
Powdery mildew.bio_remedy: Spray a solution of baking soda (1 tbsp) + liquid soap (1 tsp) per gallon of water.
Powdery mildew.chemical_remedy: Apply Wettable Sulphur 80% WDG (2g/L) or Hexaconazole 5% SC (1ml/L).

Bacterial spot.action: Avoid working in fields when wet. Remove infected plant debris.
Bacterial spot.bio_remedy: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (3g/L) + Streptocycline (0.1g/L) every 10 days.
Bacterial spot.chemical_remedy: Apply Copper Hydroxide 77% WP (2g/L) as a protectant spray.

Tomato yellow leaf curl virus.action: Remove and burn infected plants. Control whiteflies (the vector).
Tomato yellow leaf curl virus.bio_remedy: Install yellow sticky traps (10 per acre). Spray Neem oil (5ml/L).
Tomato yellow leaf curl virus.chemical_remedy: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.5ml/L) or Thiamethoxam 25% WG (0.5g/L) to control whiteflies.

Spider mites two spotted spider mite.action: Increase humidity around the plant if possible. Hose down plants with water.
Spider mites two spotted spider mite.bio_remedy: Spray Neem oil (5ml/L) or release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Spider mites two spotted spider mite.chemical_remedy: Apply Abamectin 1.9% EC (0.5ml/L) or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC (1ml/L).

Unknown.action: Monitor the plant closely for spreading symptoms. Check soil drainage.
Unknown.bio_remedy: Use a generic organic preventive like Neem oil (5ml/L).
Unknown.chemical_remedy: Consult a local agronomist before applying chemicals.
